description: Step 11b (docs/design/scenario_set_and_ablation_design.md §4.2 #8, §9 step 11): scenario #8 AI-capex credit repricing as a historical replay of Oracle's own 2025-26 CDS repricing (user decision 2026-10-18), on the credit:ORCL / credit:META issuer factors of issuer-credit-factors. Upsert: no other scenario changes. Severe tier on the production covariance (severity.severe_sigma, issuer-scenario-support): an ORCL event is an issuer event, and the 2022 crisis windows hold no ORCL history of its own.

ai_capex_credit.narrative: AI-capex credit repricing: the 1 Oct 2025 - 30 Jan 2026 replay, when Oracle's 5Y CDS went from about 54bp to about 157bp on debt-funded AI data-center capex while IG OAS stayed flat -- a single-driver credit replay (Oracle's own CDS move only, IG and META credit from the covariance; the window's AI equity rally and rates moves are excluded and filled from the covariance, with debt-funded capex names marked down by XbrlRag) of an issuer-level credit repricing that hits the long-dated ORCL 2053 / META 2054 bonds, nets against the ORCL / META CDS hedges and leaves the CDX protection sold on the common credit move.
ai_capex_credit.trigger: Debt issuance by an AI-capex issuer (8-K item 2.03 from ORCL, META, AMZN, MSFT or AAPL)

companies.narrative_query: debt-financed capital expenditures on AI and data-center infrastructure; risk that the investment does not earn expected returns and that indebtedness or credit ratings are affected
significant capital expenditures on AI and cloud data-center capacity and the financing of that investment; risk that demand does not materialise
significant capital expenditures on AI and data-center technical infrastructure that may not generate expected returns
indebtedness, access to capital markets and credit ratings; changes in the cost of debt financing
companies._calibration_note: Theme concept is debt/FCF; XbrlRag Debt resolves AMBIGUOUS -> grounding-only.

macro.synthesis_question: If debt-funded AI data-center capex leads credit markets to reprice the issuers funding it -- as when Oracle's CDS widened by about 100bp between October 2025 and January 2026 while IG credit overall stayed calm -- quantify the shocks over the scenario horizon to IG and HY credit spreads, VIX and the UST 10/30 yields, with citations. (Issuer credit and equity legs are set separately.)
